11198119.name: HU-345

11304743.name: Riociguat
11304743.description: Riociguat, sold under the brand name Adempas, is a medication by Bayer that is a stimulator of soluble guanylyl cyclase .

11493927.name: PHA-543,613
11493927.description: PHA-543,613 is a drug that acts as a potent and selective agonist for the α7 subtype of neural nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, with a high level of brain penetration and good oral bioavailability.

11504295.name: Olodaterol
11504295.description: Olodaterol is an ultra-long-acting β adrenoreceptor agonist used as an inhalation for treating people with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease . It is manufactured by Boehringer Ingelheim.

11595431.name: GW9508
11595431.description: GW9508 is an experimental drug which acts as a mixed agonist for the free fatty acid receptors FFAR1 and FFAR4 .

11765031.name: Cefpimizole

11876263.name: Desoxycorticosterone pivalate

14011047.name: 5-MeO-DPT
14011047.description: 5-MeO-DPT, also known as 5-methoxy-N,N-dipropyltryptamine, as well as O-methyl-N,N-dipropylserotonin , is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to 5-MeO-DMT.

16035495.name: Rubidium silver iodide
16035495.description: Rubidium silver iodide is a ternary inorganic compound with the formula RbAg4I5.

16122663.name: Mericitabine
16122663.description: Mericitabine is an antiviral drug, a deoxycytidine analog .

20430759.name: Sodium dithiophosphate
20430759.description: Sodium dithiophosphate is the salt with the formula Na3PS2O2.

21225127.name: Europium(II) fluoride
21225127.description: Europium fluoride is an inorganic compound with a chemical formula EuF2. It was first synthesized in 1937.

22902439.name: Nitryl azide
22902439.description: Nitryl azide is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula N3−NO2.

23662119.name: Sodium tetrahydroxyborate
23662119.description: Sodium tetrahydroxyborate is a salt with chemical formula NaH4BO4 or Na+[B 4]−.

24768935.name: BMS-641988
24768935.description: BMS-641988 is a nonsteroidal antiandrogen which was developed by Bristol-Myers Squibb for the treatment of prostate cancer but was never marketed.

24846631.name: Pentafluoromethylbenzene
24846631.description: Pentafluoromethylbenzene is a synthetic organofluoride compound with the molecular formula C6F5CH3.

25156647.name: 15,16-Dihydroxy-α-eleostearic acid
25156647.description: 15,16-Dihydroxy-α-eleostearic acid, or 15,16-Dihydroxy- -9,11,13-octadecatrienoic acid, is an organic compound with formula C18H30O4, or H3C-CH2-(-CH -)2 3- 7- OH.

25224743.name: Pyrylium-1
25224743.description: Pyrylium-1 is a fluorogenic salt of a pyrylium derivative and tetrafluoroborate.

44543271.name: 3-Chloro-N-cyclopropylcathinone
44543271.description: 3-Chloro-N-cyclopropylcathinone is a stimulant and hybrid monoamine releasing agent and monoamine reuptake inhibitor of the cathinone family related to bupropion .

44599207.name: Siponimod
44599207.description: Siponimod, sold under the brand name Mayzent, is a selective sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor modulator for oral use that is used for multiple sclerosis .

55253543.name: 5-(2-Aminopropyl)indole
55253543.description: 5- indole , also known as 3,4-pyrrolo[b]amphetamine or by the code name PAL-571, is an indole and amphetamine derivative with stimulant effects.

57465383.name: G-4 (drug)
57465383.description: G-4, also known as 3,4-tetramethylene-2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine or as 6- -5,8-dimethoxytetralin, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families.

59809191.name: Α-PHiP
59809191.description: α-Pyrrolidinoisohexanophenone is a stimulant drug of the cathinone class that has been sold online as a designer drug.

66828839.name: Glecaprevir
66828839.description: Glecaprevir is a hepatitis C virus nonstructural protein 3/4A protease inhibitor that was identified jointly by AbbVie and Enanta Pharmaceuticals.

71262247.name: Ziresovir
71262247.description: Ziresovir is an antiviral drug which was developed as a treatment for respiratory syncytial virus. It acts as a fusion inhibitor, and has shown good results in Phase II and III clinical trials.

71308199.name: Flavogallonic acid dilactone
71308199.description: Flavogallonic acid dilactone is a hydrolysable tannin that can be found in Rhynchosia volubilis seeds, in Shorea laevifolia, in Anogeissus leiocarpus and Terminalia avicennoides.

71588007.name: 2-Bromodeschloroketamine

73777063.name: GPR120 compound A
73777063.description: GPR120 compound A is an experimental drug which acts as a potent and highly selective agonist for the free fatty acid receptor FFAR4 .

78318119.name: Rezafungin
78318119.description: Rezafungin, sold under the brand name Rezzayo , is a medication used for the treatment of invasive candidiasis.

91827367.name: Faricimab
91827367.description: Faricimab, sold under the brand name Vabysmo , is a monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of neovascular age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema .

101343655.name: Mycosamine
101343655.description: D-Mycosamine is an amino sugar found in several polyene antimycotics. Structural analogs of these agents lacking this monosaccharide component do not exhibit substantial antifungal activity.

101943079.name: Disulfuryl chloride fluoride
101943079.description: Disulfuryl chloride fluoride is an inorganic compound of sulfur, chlorine, fluorine, and oxygen with the chemical formula S2O5ClF.

102210471.name: 4-Caffeoyl-1,5-quinide
102210471.description: 4-Caffeoyl-1,5-quinide is found in roasted coffee beans.

102378663.name: Triangulene

118856359.name: Curium(IV) oxide
118856359.description: Curium oxide is an inorganic chemical compound of curium and oxygen with the chemical formula CmO2. Since all isotopes of curium are man-made, the compound does not occur in nature.

129050791.name: Mefluleucine
129050791.description: Mefluleucine (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name; developmental code names NV-5138, SPN-820) is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Navitor Pharmaceuticals and Supernus...

130306983.name: Safusidenib
130306983.description: Safusidenib is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by AnHeart Therapeutics and the Daiichi Sankyo Company for the treatment of IDH1-mutant glioma.

132472359.name: A-230
132472359.description: A-230 is an organophosphate nerve agent. It was developed in the Soviet Union under the FOLIANT program and is one of the group of compounds referred to as Novichok agents that were revealed by Vil...

135571111.name: Alloxydim
135571111.description: Alloxydim is a chemical compound. Its formula is C17H25NO5.

136247207.name: Cyclic adenosine-inosine monophosphate
136247207.description: Cyclic adenosine-inosine monophosphate is an experimental antiviral drug.

137322663.name: BAY-293
137322663.description: BAY-293 is the first drug reported to act as an inhibitor of the guanine nucleotide exchange factor protein SOS1.

138454311.name: 4-AcO-EPT
138454311.description: 4-AcO-EPT, also known as 4-acetoxy-N-ethyl-N-propyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to 4-AcO-DMT .

139331495.name: Aficamten
139331495.description: Aficamten, sold under the brand name Myqorzo, is a medication used for the treatment of symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

156588967.name: Flunitazene
156588967.description: Flunitazene is a benzimidazole derivative with opioid effects, first developed in the 1950s as part of the research that led to better-known compounds such as etonitazene.

156614055.name: Trichloro(dichlorophenyl)silane
156614055.description: Trichloro silane is a family of chemical compounds, all with formula Si Cl3. It is used as an intermediate in the manufacture of silicones.

166177191.name: Flotufolastat (18F)
166177191.description: Flotufolastat , sold under the brand name Posluma, is a radioactive diagnostic agent for use with positron emission tomography imaging for prostate cancer.

900000039.name: 2CI-2-EtO
900000039.description: 2CI-2-EtO, also known as 2-ethoxy-5-methoxy-4-iodophenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and TWEETIO families related to the psychedelic drug 2C-I.

900000167.name: Amylose
900000167.description: Amylose is a polysaccharide made of α-D-glucose units, bonded to each other through α glycosidic bonds.

900000423.name: Cassiffix
900000423.description: Cassiffix is a fragrance compound with the molecular formula C16H26O. According to International Flavors & Fragrances Inc., it has a "fruity, green, cassis note."

900000551.name: DTaP-Hib vaccine
900000551.description: DTaP-Hib vaccine is a combination vaccine whose generic name is diphtheria and tetanus toxoids and acellular pertussis adsorbed with Haemophilus B conjugate vaccine, sometimes abbreviated to DTaP-Hib.

900000679.name: EVT-103
900000679.description: EVT-103, also known as ENS-103, is an experimental medication which originated from Roche and is under development by Evotec AG for the treatment of major depressive disorder.

900000935.name: Hepatitis C vaccine
900000935.description: A hepatitis C vaccine, a vaccine capable of protecting against the hepatitis C virus , is not yet available.

900001063.name: JZP-386

900001319.name: Namilumab
900001319.description: Namilumab is a human monoclonal antibody that targets granulocyte macrophage-colony stimulating factor /colony stimulating factor 2 and is currently being researched for application in rheumatoid...

900001447.name: Oxonium hexafluorouranate
900001447.description: Oxonium hexafluorouranate is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula H3OUF6, composed of the hydroxonium cation [H3O]+ and hexafluorouranate anion [UF6]-.

900001575.name: Plutonium tetroxide
900001575.description: Plutonium tetraoxide is an inorganic binary compound of plutonium and oxygen with the chemical formula PuO4.

900001703.name: Praseodymium oxyfluoride
900001703.description: Praseodymium oxyfluoride or praseodymium oxide fluoride is an inorganic compound of praseodymium, oxygen, and fluorine with the chemical formula PrOF.

900001959.name: Tabalumab
900001959.description: Tabalumab is an anti-B-cell activating factor human monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of autoimmune diseases and B cell malignancies.
